status: DRAFT tip text for Cam to edit (15 Nov 2026). Written in our own words from the consensus of NZC, ECB, CSA, ICC-Europe and Namibia coaching manuals, research and Cam's points; no official wording is copied.

tips.F01: Keep your head still and your eyes level as the bowler lets go, so you get the best view of the ball.
tips.F02: Stand with your weight on the balls of your feet and your knees relaxed, so you're ready to move forward or back.
tips.F03: Lift the bat so it can come down straight; if it goes out wide, it will tend to swing across the line.
tips.F04: Let your head and front shoulder lead you towards the ball, and your front foot will follow.
tips.F05: Stride towards the pitch of the ball and land just inside its line, so you don't have to reach for it.
tips.F06: Bend your front knee as you land so your weight goes forward onto it instead of staying on your back foot.
tips.F07: Keep your front shoulder pointing at the line of the ball until you've hit it; opening up early pulls the bat across.
tips.F08: Swing the bat straight through the line of the ball, with the full face pointing where you want it to go.
tips.F09: Make it one smooth movement: let the front foot settle and the bat follow, without stopping and starting.
tips.F10: Get your head over the ball and hit it under your eyes, next to your front pad, to keep it on the ground.
tips.F11: Hold your finish for a count of two; if you can't, your head was falling away, so keep it over your front knee.
tips.F12: Push your hands through towards your target and finish high with the bat under control.
tips.F13: Start lifting your hands a fraction earlier, as the bowler is about to let go, so the swing isn't rushed.
tips.F14: Turn your front shoulder towards the line of the ball so the bat has room to come straight through.
tips.F15: Move forward towards the ball rather than across the crease, so your head stays in line and you can hit straight.
tips.F16: Get your weight moving forward so your head and chest end up over your front foot, not behind it.
tips.F00: Nothing major to fix: a good, balanced drive. Keep repeating it.
